label: Проверяемое состояние cron-потребителей TelegramAuto
description: Добавить source-owned результат штатного cron и вызов source checks в действующие caller seams. Не запускать повторно бизнес-задачу ради проверки и не объявлять старый успешный запуск свежим восстановлением.
acceptance: Подтверждённый новый результат источника снимает failure; отсутствие измерения остаётся unknown; recovery сохраняет эпизод и не даёт агенту источник-полномочия; существующие cron вызовы мигрированы.
note: Published source slice e138ecd to origin/main; authoritative ls-remote and local HEAD both e138ecdbc5c377513597d35ffe609b7b579d7bde. V2 remains opt-in. Due request transport filters by exact measured signal so other same-source cron requests stay pending; problem_type is omitted and falls back to each signal, never generic unknown. Fresh SQL measures view-hourly; fresh sampler timestamp measures sampler-stale; unsupported/business signals are not marked healthy. Targeted tests 16 passed and mandatory push gate 16 passed; shell syntax, py_compile, diff check passed. Runtime status remains source-published only: helper install/grant and protected env marker are not present from this worker; no deploy/restart/live call. Caller classification: service speed/degraded and weekly audit are business/SLA/config findings; subs-ramp stall is business outcome; sampler-stale is runtime health with current timestamp probe. ATV submodule systemd canary and untracked ops/cron tree are outside these owned paths; QA/test callers are not activated. Foreign tracked/untracked WIP and data remain untouched. Code map key telegramauto-noticeplace-cron-lifecycle verified at the published HEAD.
result: e138ecdbc5c377513597d35ffe609b7b579d7bde published origin/main. Requires /opt/noticeplace SDK (L06), authorized consumer policy (L13), then NOTICEPLACE_CONSUMER_V2=1 in protected /etc/default/autotelegramviews. Runtime installation not claimed.
estimate_over_limit_reason: Исходный пакет ATV/TGC cron consumers сохраняет ID с отдельными adapter/test receipts; реальная установка отдельно L18.
